links.outcome: Ablation of retrieval versus fine-tuning on reference-based and faithfulness metrics
links.effect: Retrieval was the dominant performance lever; fine-tuning added further gains in stylistic and faithfulness quality. Full system gained +82% faithfulness over the base model (p<0.001).
links.quote: Ablation analysis showed that retrieval was the dominant performance lever, with fine-tuning adding consistent further gains in stylistic and faithfulness quality.

unlisted_practices: Domain-specific QLoRA fine-tuning of a small LLM on curated textbook Q&A
Using a small domain-adapted RAG model instead of larger general-purpose LLMs

screen.reason: The study conducts an ablation analysis demonstrating the impact of adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounding to an LLM for clinical QA in pediatric gynecology, benchmarking it against base models and frontier models.
